S44.01.needs: A signed-in Cloud account with image access (a paid plan or free daily image quota)
S44.01.note: Images screen is reached from the drawer label Images (src/features/drawer/components/DrawerContent.tsx).
steps: Sign in and open a chat in Cloud mode (image creation must be available on the account).
Tap the + button labelled Add to chat, then tap Create image.
Type a prompt in the message box and send.
Wait for the card Generating Image to finish, then check that a generated image appears in the conversation and matches Expected.
S44.01.where: Chat > Add to chat (+) > Create image, then type a prompt and send. Or Drawer > Images > Describe an image, then Create image.

S44.02.needs: A Cloud account with image access and at least two image models offered
S44.02.note: The model list comes from the shared catalog for the active kind; the Images screen itself has no model picker.
steps: Open a chat in Cloud mode and tap the + button labelled Add to chat.
Tap Create image.
Under the heading Image model, look at the list of models and tap a different model.
Check that the tapped row is now marked selected, then send a prompt.
Open the generated image and read the caption Generated with <model name> to compare with the model you picked.
S44.02.where: Chat > Add to chat (+) > Create image > Image model

labels.text: Attach up to 4 photos. The first is edited; the rest guide it.

S44.04.needs: A photo to upload; a model that accepts reference photos (the chat sheet shows a note when it does not)
S44.04.note: The attachment slots are shown as a strip on the Images screen (testID images.references); the visible word for each slot is not written as a label.
steps: Open Images from the drawer, or open a chat, tap the + button, then tap Create image.
On Images, tap the button labelled Attach photos and choose a photo.
In the chat sheet, tap Photos and choose up to 4 photos (shown in the hint text under Image model).
Check that the chosen photos appear as attachments above the prompt box.
Send the prompt and check that the first photo is edited and the others guide the result.
S44.04.where: Drawer > Images > Attach photos (paperclip). Or Chat > Add to chat (+) > Create image > Photos.

S44.07.needs: A Cloud account with image access; a model that offers more than one ratio (the section is hidden otherwise)
S44.07.note: The option labels come from getImageAspectOptionsForModel; the tester sees whatever ratio names that returns.
steps: Open a chat in Cloud mode, tap the + button, then tap Create image.
Under the heading Aspect ratio, tap a different ratio.
Check that the tapped row is marked selected.
Send a prompt and open the generated image.
Compare the image shape with the ratio you picked.
S44.07.where: Chat > Add to chat (+) > Create image > Aspect ratio

S44.11.needs: A Cloud account with image access and an editing-capable image model
S44.11.note: The hint under the row reads Return the image without a background; the row is hidden for text-only models.
steps: Open a chat in Cloud mode, tap the + button, then tap Create image.
Pick an image model that accepts reference photos (the row only appears for those models).
Tap Transparent background so the row is marked selected.
Send a prompt and open the generated image.
Check that the background is removed (transparent) in the result.
S44.11.where: Chat > Add to chat (+) > Create image > Transparent background

S44.18.needs: A Cloud account with image access; a fast enough moment to tap before the image finishes
S44.18.note: The code only sends a stop request from the card; whether the job is cancelled and not billed is not shown on screen.
steps: Send an image prompt in Cloud mode.
While the card shows Generating Image, tap the button labelled Stop generating.
Check that the card stops progressing and no image is added to the conversation.
Check whether a charge or credit use appears afterwards (not verifiable from the code).
S44.18.where: Chat > send an image prompt > tap Stop generating on the image card

S44.19.needs: A Cloud account with image access and a way to produce a failed generation
S44.19.note: A stopped generation may not reach the failed state that shows Retry; the code does not confirm that. Long-press message actions also have Retry (src/features/chat/components/MessageBubble.tsx).
steps: Make an image generation fail, or use one that shows Image Generation Failed.
Tap the button labelled Retry on the card.
Check that a new generation starts with the same prompt in the same place in the chat.

S44.21.needs: At least one image created earlier on the account
S44.21.note: The Images screen (Drawer > Images) also has a grid titled Your images.
steps: Open the drawer and tap Library.
Tap the filter chip labelled Images.
Look for the images in a grid of tiles.
Tap a tile to open it, then compare with Expected.
Tap a generated image in a chat, or an image tile in Library.
Check that it opens full screen on a black background.
Use the zoom controls (Zoom in, Zoom out) or pinch to zoom.
Tap Close in the top bar to return.
S44.22.where: Chat > tap a generated image. Or Drawer > Library > Images > tap a tile.

S44.23.needs: A generated image made with a prompt
S44.23.note: The caption shows only the model and aspect ratio. Quality and size are not written anywhere in the viewer code.
steps: Tap a generated image in a chat to open the full-screen viewer.
Read the prompt text shown under the image.
Read the caption that starts with Generated with, which shows the model name and the aspect ratio.
Compare with Expected: check whether quality and size are shown.
S44.23.where: Chat > tap a generated image > read the text under the picture

S44.25.needs: A Cloud account with a previously generated image
S44.25.note: Remix is shown only in Cloud mode. The code sets the model and the prompt; it does not show a code path that sets the aspect ratio.
steps: Open Library from the drawer and tap the Images chip.
Long-press an image tile to open its menu.
Tap Remix.
Check that the chat opens in image mode with the earlier prompt and model selected, and compare with Expected (ratio is not clearly set by this path).
S44.25.where: Drawer > Library > Images > long-press an image > Remix

S44.27.needs: A Cloud account with image access; a temporary chat for the Save to Library option
S44.27.note: Images in normal chats are not shown with a Save to Library option; the code does not show a manual save there. Whether they reach the Library automatically is not confirmed by this audit.
steps: Open a temporary chat in Cloud mode and generate an image.
Long-press the image.
Tap Save to Library and wait for the message Saved to your Library.
Open Drawer > Library > Images and check that the image is there.
S44.27.where: Chat (temporary chat) > long-press a generated image > Save to Library

S44.29.needs: A phone or simulator with Photos access allowed
S44.29.note: The visible word is Save to Photos, not Download. Full quality is not confirmed by the screen text.
steps: Tap a generated image to open the full-screen viewer.
Tap the download icon labelled Save image to Photos.
Allow Photos access if the system asks.
Open the Photos app and find the saved image, then compare its size with Expected.
S44.29.where: Chat > tap a generated image > Save image to Photos

S44.30.needs: A phone with a text field in another app
S44.30.note: The same action is in the long-press menu on the image in the chat (src/features/chat/components/GeneratedImage.tsx).
steps: Tap a generated image to open the full-screen viewer.
Tap the button labelled Copy image.
Check that the icon changes and the label reads Image copied.
Paste into a text field in another app and check that the image pastes.
S44.30.where: Chat > tap a generated image > Copy image

S44.31.needs: A phone with at least one other app that accepts images
steps: Tap a generated image to open the full-screen viewer.
Tap the button labelled Share image.
Choose another app from the share sheet, such as Messages or Mail.
Check that the image is attached in that app before sending.
S44.31.where: Chat > tap a generated image > Share image

S44.33.needs: A generated image from an image model that can edit; the button is hidden for models that cannot
S44.33.note: Edit an area of this image (Paintbrush) is the area-edit option on the same bar. The Change option is hidden for attachments.
steps: Tap a generated image in a chat whose model can edit images.
Tap the button labelled Change this image.
Type the change in the box labelled Describe the change, for example a colour change, and submit.
Compare the new image with the original and check that the same picture was changed.
S44.33.where: Chat > tap a generated image > Change this image

S44.35.needs: A generated image; a test image only, since a report is sent to trust and safety
S44.35.note: The same report is also in the chat message actions as Report… (the file text is Report with an ellipsis escape).
steps: Tap a generated image to open the full-screen viewer.
Tap the flag button labelled Report this image.
Choose a reason in the report sheet and submit it (use a test image only).
Read the confirmation and check it says what happened to the report.
S44.35.where: Chat > tap a generated image > Report this image

S44.36.note: No visible AI-generated label was found in apps/mobile (searched AI-generated, AI generated, provenance). The legal screen EU AI Act Article 50 describes a C2PA-style claim; the file route sets the claim headers (apps/web/app/api/files/[id]/route.ts).
S44.36.where: Not shown on the image in the app. The AI claim is sent with the file download.
